part.text:
GA Selenite Tower `63C0668B` — read-only bundle review. Passes first, then blocking defects.

Pass verified: `1/combat +3/victory` staged once via `_workshop_reward_staged`, `price_for 2/4 cap 2`, `apply_permanent_health_bonus`, `TEMP verified via _read_file`, `backup-remove after success returns true`, workshop `460..640` vs elevator `872 / 908..1010+36` disjoint, `1/2` checks `keycode+physical_keycode`, choice click blocked.

**D1 lobby nil deref — `scripts/world/lobby.gd`:**
Expr: `_workshop.update_near(_player, not bool(_player.get("is_dead")))` vs guard in `_can_board`: `is_instance_valid(_player) and _player!=null`.
Repro: missing/freed `Player` → physics calls `.get` on Nil → error, lobby frozen. `update_near` itself guards internally but caller crashes first.
Fix: `is_instance_valid(_player) and not bool(_player.get("is_dead"))`.

**D2 lone-corrupt deadlocks, no recovery docs — `workshop_save.gd` + `iris_workshop.gd`:**
Expr: `if not bool(read_state().get("valid",false)): return false` + `if primary_exists: return {"valid":false}` + UI: `"Não foi possível ler o progresso da oficina. O arquivo foi preservado."`
Repro: garbage `user://iris_workshop.cfg` with no `.bak` → `buy/_credit/save_pending_rewards` always `false`, pending stays in `SceneTree` meta only, retry never succeeds.
Fix: document `user://iris_workshop.cfg/.bak/.tmp` + delete/rename steps in UI/log.

**D3 pending count lost — `run_controller.gd::_workshop_reward_text`:**
Expr success: `"MARCAS DA OFICINA +%d" % _workshop_reward` vs fail: `"MARCAS PENDENTES ATÉ SAIR DO JOGO"` (no `N`).
Repro: corrupt save → finish `N` combats + victory → cannot verify `N+3`.
Fix: include count in pending string.

**D4 skip focus points to hidden choices on load-fail — `intro_cutscene.gd`:**
Expr `_set_line_content`: `_skip_button.focus_previous/next = ... _choice_buttons[...]` vs `_finish_intro`: `for button in _choice_buttons: button.hide()` with no neighbor reset.
Repro: choice line → lobby load fails → retry UI shows `Advance`, `Skip.next/prev` still hidden `ChoiceFirst/Second` → Tab stuck.
Fix: reset skip neighbors to `_advance_button` in `_finish_intro`.
